BRANDON, and a Sergeant-at-Arms. Door-keeper of the Council-chamber. Porter, and his Page to Gardiner. A QUEEN KATHARINE, wife to Henry, afterwards divorced. BULLEN, her Maid of Honour, afterwards An old Lady, friend to PATIENCE, woman to Queen Katharine.
